store.summary: Record & replay 433 MHz remotes and read, write & emulate NFC cards
store.description: Two tools for the CC1101+NFC cap. Sub-GHz: record a 433 MHz remote (like a garage opener), save it and replay it, with the CC1101 radio. NFC: read, write and emulate 13.56 MHz cards, with the ST25R3916. Pick a tool with the arrows and ENTER; ESC goes back, hold ESC to exit. Note: fixed-code remotes can be replayed; rolling-code (KeeLoq) remotes cannot, by design.
